resample_verification.rule: every target is produced and its aggregation contract checked, not only the interval the regime model happens to consume

crypto_binance_spot_1m.bar_close_rule: derived: time + interval (the stored close_time is untrusted)

crypto_binance_futures_1m.bar_close_rule: derived: time + interval (the stored close_time is untrusted)

crypto_binance_futures_metrics_5m.bar_close_rule: derived: time + interval (the stored close_time is untrusted)

crypto_binance_orderbook_snapshot_1h.bar_close_rule: derived: time + interval (the stored close_time is untrusted)

resampling.flow_columns: summed in their own units; fractional volume never truncated
resampling.level_columns: open interest and ratios take the LAST value, never a sum
resampling.incomplete_buckets: dropped, never aggregated over a hole
resampling.labelling: left-labelled; the bucket open is the row's `time`

funding.policy: a missing funding history is NEVER treated as zero carry. Any cohort that would need funding is marked missing, and a no-funding study carries its own disclaimer (guide 4.1).
funding.consequence_for_primary: the primary economic contract runs with use_funding=False and is labelled a no-funding cohort; it may not claim realistic net carry

snapshot_products.crypto_binance_orderbook_snapshot_1h: availability comes from the real sample_time, not the hour label (T26)

fail_closed: a primary read raises on a quality failure; it never warns and continues
